{"data":{"help":{"id":"21YhZAfdNhurYuaFu6lMtK","identifier":"what-is-publisher-endorsement","title":"What is publisher endorsement?","body":"

New data publishers need to be endorsed by a GBIF Participant. This process is in place to ensure that the publisher is a legitimate organization with data relevant to GBIF’s scope and objectives. More details in the criteria and guidelines for endorsement.
